snippet.title: Rust Console Edition (New Gen) - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Rust Console Edition is now fully optimized for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Experience the ultimate survival game with upgraded visuals, smoother performance, and a wave of new features designed for next-gen consoles. From building animations and hot air balloons to minis and other surprises, there's a lot to discover right from the start.

Whether you're building a base, teaming up with friends, or defending yourself against enemies, one thing’s clear: only the strongest will survive.
